content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for Income Tax Department Gujarat Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Counsels shall not advise, hold briefs or appear against the Department in direct tax matters. A counsel's partner firm must not take up cases against the Department as described in the guidelines. Private practice is allowed if it does not interfere with duties to the Department. Desirable: Experience in dealing with Income tax / Direct tax matters Senior Standing Counsels should preferably be taken from Junior Standing Counsels of at least three years' standing

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Eligible to appear before the High Court as an advocate, with minimum 5 years of handling direct tax matters before High Courts or ITAT as an advocate; or Junior Standing Counsel of the Department for 3 years; or an eligible retired/resigned officer or former ITAT member. Experience required: Minimum 5 years of handling direct tax matters before High Courts or ITAT as an advocate; or Junior Standing Counsel of the Department for 3 years; or a retired/resigned Income-tax officer of Addl. Commissioner/Director or equivalent post held for at least 3 years, or any higher post, or a former ITAT member, subject to disciplinary conditions. Qualification required: Eligible to appear before the High Court as an advocate, with minimum 3 years of handling preferably direct tax matters before High Courts or ITAT; or an eligible retired/resigned Income-tax officer. Experience required: Minimum 3 years of handling preferably direct tax matters before High Courts or ITAT; or a retired/resigned Income-tax officer of Additional/Joint CIT or below who is eligible to appear before the High Court as an advocate, subject to disciplinary conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Standing Counsels are engaged under the revised schedule of fees and related terms in Annexure-II of Instruction No. 7/2016. Engagement of the panel shall normally be for three years. Either side may terminate the engagement by written intimation without assigning any reason. On expiry, termination or resignation, the counsel shall immediately hand over briefs and related papers. Pending bills shall be settled within three months of submission of the bill.

content_sections.heading: How Will Income Tax Department Gujarat Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Evaluation of applications by the Screening Committee Interview by the Committee Marks awarded under Proforma B-1 or B-2 Evaluation report and CCIT recommendation sent to the Board in Proforma-B The Committee examines expertise in direct tax matters, aptitude for interpretation and suitability to represent the Department in an interview. Marks are awarded on the Proforma B-1 or B-2 parameters, out of a maximum of 100. The Committee fixes a minimum benchmark; candidates below it are not considered irrespective of vacancies. Senior candidates' suitability considers drafting quality, assistance to appearing counsels and co-ordination with officers. A panel buffer of at least 25% or a workable buffer should be considered; buffer names receive no remuneration.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Documentary proof of educational qualification Proof of date of enrolment as an advocate and registration number Proof of the number of direct tax cases dealt with (Proforma A1) Copy of the latest I.T. return (Proforma A1)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Income Tax Department Gujarat Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain Instruction No. 7/2016 from the website or from the office at 3rd floor, Aayakar Bhavan, Ashram Road, Ahmedabad 380009. Fill in Proforma A1 or A2 of Annexure I, as applicable. Attach the necessary documentary evidence. Submit in a sealed cover to the O/o the Pr. Commissioner of Income Tax (Judicial), Tapal Section, Aayakar Bhavan, Ashram Road, Ahmedabad 380009. Make sure it reaches by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Income Tax Department Gujarat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Income Tax Department Gujarat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Proforma A1 and A2 of Annexure I, Instruction No. 7/2016) and send it to O/o the Pr. Commissioner of Income Tax (Judicial), Tapal Section, Aayakar Bhavan, Ashram Road, Ahmedabad 380009, by sealed cover, submitted physically, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for Income Tax Department Gujarat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fee-based engagement under the revised schedule of fees in Annexure-II of Instruction No. 7/2016.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Advocates enrolled in the High Court and members of its Bar Council. Senior: 5 years' direct tax experience or another listed route. Junior: 3 years' experience or another listed route. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. Counsels shall not advise, hold briefs or appear against the Department in direct tax matters. A counsel's partner firm must not take up cases against the Department as described in the guidelines. Private practice is allowed if it does not interfere with duties to the Department.

faq.answer: Retired/resigned officers removed, dismissed or compulsorily retired on account of disciplinary action. Retired/resigned officers against whom disciplinary proceedings under service or pension rules are pending.
